svg.text: ESP32-C3 SuperMini to the u-blox LEA-M8T (Huawei WD22UGRC card, J2)
SuperMini seen from the component side, USB-C up. The GPS board is a schematic: pads in board order, not to scale.
Supply: 3.3 V only. Default UART speed: 9600 baud.
ESP32 RX from GPS TX (NMEA / UBX)
ESP32 TX to GPS RX (commands, RTCM corrections)
3.3 V ONLY. The card has no regulator: 5 V destroys the module.
Find pin 1 with a meter before powering anything. GND (8) buzzes to the corner mounting pads; VANT (1) reads a
few ohms to the SMB centre pin.
VANT is the antenna bias input. Link it to V+ for a 3.3 V active antenna; leave it open for a passive one.
Default UART speed is 9600 baud. The J2 pinout is reverse-engineered and has not been powered yet.
